title: PPIA-16 Developer Console Screen State Contracts
purpose: Define deterministic per-screen states and recovery-safe interaction behavior for P16-SCR-001 through P16-SCR-010 without implementing a runtime console or granting new authority.

global_state_vocabulary.meaning: Required controlling sources are available and internally consistent for the displayed operation.
The source validly contains no records/results for the selected scope.
Displayed projection/evidence belongs to an older source timestamp/ref/candidate than the controlling state.
Two material sources disagree and precedence/reconciliation is required.
A declared authority, prerequisite, adapter, source, stop condition or blocking finding prevents valid continuation.
The requested observation/action failed unexpectedly or returned invalid/unreadable evidence.
The console is reconciling interrupted work, uncertain operation status, or refreshed authority/evidence.

transition_invariants: Only repository/tool evidence may drive state transitions; animation, elapsed time, navigation or user optimism cannot upgrade state.
stale may transition to ready only after the controlling source/candidate is re-read and candidate-bound evidence is revalidated.
conflict may transition to ready only after precedence or reconciliation is explicit; never by dropping one source silently.
blocked may transition only when the named blocker is removed or owning authority changes; retrying the same blocked operation alone is insufficient.
error and recovering never authorize mutation; ambiguous mutation status requires lookup/recovery before any retry.
Only completed_verified may be rendered as overall work completion.

screens.name: Developer Cockpit Overview

screen_specific_states.oracle: current work is known but one or more noncontrolling health/evidence sources are unavailable; derived summary is visibly incomplete

state_oracles.ready: pointer, checkpoint and active branch evidence agree on one unfinished operation
state_oracles.blocked: active checkpoint names an unresolved required blocker

screens.mobile: single-column order: work identity, next action, authority strip, blockers/findings, evidence, deferred tracks; safety context is never collapsed away
screens.nonvisual: announce work item, raw lifecycle state, next action and blocker count before secondary summaries

screens.name: Current Work & Scope Authority

screen_specific_states.oracle: governed work exists but exact changed-path authority is absent; preliminary roots remain labeled non-authoritative
DT-003 output is PREPARED and prerequisites are not all satisfied
DT-003 output is READY_TO_EXECUTE but external work-order gates still apply

state_oracles.ready: owning work order/checkpoint and exact scope authority are resolved
state_oracles.blocked: stop condition or missing required authority prevents prepared execution

screens.mobile: scope rows become labeled cards preserving path, authority class and stop condition
screens.nonvisual: source-stack precedence precedes task-capsule status; PREPARED/READY_TO_EXECUTE is read verbatim

screens.name: Repository Health & Preflight

screen_specific_states.oracle: DT-001/DT-002 returns WARN and work may continue with visible caveat
all selected declared checks return PASS within tool scope

state_oracles.pass: raw PASS from selected doctor/preflight checks
state_oracles.warn: at least one raw WARN and no BLOCK
state_oracles.blocked: raw BLOCK or missing prerequisite prevents declared check

screens.mobile: health groups remain separate; raw result and source remain adjacent
screens.nonvisual: announce raw PASS/WARN/BLOCK and scope before human-readable explanation

screens.name: Fixtures & Scenario Laboratory

screen_specific_states.oracle: fixture class/identity/provenance validates without contradiction
role-safe authoritative=false projection exists
deterministic scenario/replay evidence PASS for exact fixture/scenario inputs
scenario ran and an assertion failed without hidden-data disclosure

state_oracles.blocked: scenario requires owning-domain mutation but adapter/authority is absent
state_oracles.recovering: scenario operation status or replay continuity is uncertain

screens.mobile: fixture, projection and scenario phases are ordered steps rather than hidden tabs
screens.nonvisual: step evidence is an ordered list with digest/status text; no map or color-only meaning

screens.name: Privacy & Design Quality

screen_specific_states.oracle: DT-006 supplied scan scope has zero findings
one or more DT-006 findings exist and are blocking for supplied scope
DT-008 full audit reports legacy WARN debt only
changed-since lint identifies newly added violation

state_oracles.blocked: privacy finding or newly added design violation blocks declared gate
state_oracles.stale: finding fingerprints/candidate no longer match selected source

screens.mobile: privacy and design remain separate labeled sections; filters open as keyboard/touch operable controls
screens.nonvisual: finding rows expose raw source rule, severity/state, locator, blocking effect and safe summary without protected payload

screens.name: UI Evidence Workspace

screen_specific_states.oracle: capture plan is valid and exact candidate is bound
planned existing PNG/metadata evidence passes integrity checks
capture requires explicit browser adapter and none is available
synthetic CI image is valid only as tool-test evidence

state_oracles.stale: evidence SHA differs from selected exact candidate
state_oracles.blocked: required browser adapter/attestation/evidence integrity is missing
state_oracles.ready: candidate-bound plan/evidence is valid within declared scope

screens.mobile: matrix collapses into per-capture cards retaining viewport/density/role/theme/state and candidate chip
screens.nonvisual: screenshots require textual metadata/attestation; image alone never carries pass/fail meaning

screens.name: Traceability & Proof Explorer

screen_specific_states.oracle: occurrences exist but no structured relation exists
structured links exist without qualifying proof relation
integrity-valid PASS/COMPLETE proof relation binds exact candidate/evidence

state_oracles.empty: ID has no occurrence in selected roots
state_oracles.blocked: graph integrity error prevents trustworthy proof state
state_oracles.stale: proof candidate/evidence is older than selected candidate

screens.mobile: occurrences and relations become separate ordered sections; proof state remains text
screens.nonvisual: UNDECLARED/DECLARED/PROVEN is announced verbatim with candidate/evidence identity

screens.name: CI, Evidence Receipts & Findings

screen_specific_states.oracle: some applicable workflows succeeded but the exact-head matrix is incomplete
all hosted workflows are green but another declared completion evidence kind is missing
all declared exact-head validations/evidence kinds for the selected gate are satisfied; lifecycle is still shown from checkpoint

state_oracles.blocked: one or more required current exact-head checks failed or required receipt is absent
state_oracles.stale: receipt/run is bound to another candidate

screens.mobile: workflow rows reduce to name/raw status/run; evidence-kind checklist follows candidate identity
screens.nonvisual: success count is never the sole indicator; missing/failed checks and candidate mismatch are explicitly announced

screens.name: Recovery & Performance Harness

screen_specific_states.oracle: built-in reference recovery probe PASS, explicitly not product proof
case requires real product adapter and none is supplied
performance probe lacks numerical budget or budget_source
valid sourced budget exists and one or more samples violate it

state_oracles.blocked: required adapter or budget authority is absent
state_oracles.ready: plan is valid and result scope is explicit
state_oracles.stale: adapter/candidate/plan identity no longer matches current selection

screens.mobile: case cards keep evidence scope, adapter requirement, raw result, digest and budget source together
screens.nonvisual: timing tables expose textual units, threshold and violation status; charts are optional duplicates only

screens.name: Interruption Recovery & AI-Team Handoff

screen_specific_states.oracle: one exact unfinished operation, branch/ref, next action, blockers and gate are source-backed
pointer/checkpoint/branch/PR evidence materially contradicts and unrelated mutation must stop

state_oracles.handoff-ready: recovery sources resolve one exact unfinished operation
state_oracles.stale: handoff packet predates newer branch/checkpoint evidence
state_oracles.blocked: owner-only or unresolved required blocker prevents next execution

screens.mobile: recovery sequence is fixed: work identity, last verified action, blocker, next action, completion gate, task packet
screens.nonvisual: handoff content is available as ordered text and copy/export content without visual dependency

interaction_modes.keyboard: Every control reachable in logical source-to-action order; no drag-only or hover-only workflow; Escape closes nonmodal disclosure without losing task state.
interaction_modes.screen_reader: State changes use concise live announcements only for changed raw state/blocker/action availability; logs and findings never auto-stream entire bodies.
interaction_modes.high_zoom: At 200%+ required authority, candidate, raw status and next action reflow before secondary metadata; no horizontal scroll is required for core task completion.
interaction_modes.mobile_touch: Minimum target sizing follows platform accessibility norms; destructive/externally governed actions are never adjacent unlabeled icon-only targets; semantic order matches desktop.
interaction_modes.reduced_motion: No state meaning depends on motion; transitions may be instantaneous without information loss.
interaction_modes.noncolor: Every status uses text/raw token/icon shape in addition to any color.
